listen.title: 3분기 실적 발표
lines: Good morning, everyone. Today I'll give you a quick overview of our third-quarter results.
As you can see on this slide, sales grew by twelve percent compared to last year.
I'd like to highlight two reasons for this. First, our online channel doubled. Second, we cut delivery times in half.
However, marketing costs also rose significantly.
To sum up, we had a strong quarter, but we need to watch our spending.
listen.dict: We need to watch our spending.

read.title: Retailer Reports Strong Online Growth
read.text:
Bluebay, a mid-sized home goods retailer, reported a significant rise in online sales for the second quarter. According to figures released on Tuesday, online revenue increased by 35 percent, while store sales stayed flat.

The company's CEO said the growth came mainly from a new mobile app launched in March. "Customers now do most of their browsing on their phones," she said. Bluebay plans to close five stores next year and invest the savings in faster delivery.

Analysts said the move makes sense but warned that competition in online retail remains intense.
